about: Invalid bench configurations and the message each build refuses them with. `device` is the device's TOML body after `name` (it must set protocol_address), `points` the point tables. `rust` and `c` are the module's message, without any prefix the binary adds; null means the build accepts the config.

cases.name: change above 1
cases.rust: point 'p1' on device 'plc0' address: 'change' must be a number from 0 to 1
cases.c: point 'p1' on device 'plc0' address: 'change' must be a number from 0 to 1

cases.name: batch of 0
cases.rust: device 'plc0' protocol_address: 'batch' must be a positive integer
cases.c: device 'plc0' protocol_address: 'batch' must be a positive integer

cases.name: negative push rate
cases.rust: device 'plc0' protocol_address: 'push_rate' must be a number of 0 or more
cases.c: device 'plc0' protocol_address: 'push_rate' must be a number of 0 or more

cases.name: first unknown key in sort order
latency not a duration
cases.rust: device 'plc0' protocol_address: 'latency' must be a duration such as "2ms"
cases.c: device 'plc0' protocol_address: 'latency' must be a duration such as "2ms"

cases.name: unknown model
cases.rust: point 'p1' on device 'plc0' address: 'model' must be "walk", "constant" or "counter"
cases.c: point 'p1' on device 'plc0' address: 'model' must be "walk", "constant" or "counter"

cases.name: negative step
cases.rust: point 'p1' on device 'plc0' address: 'step' must be a finite number of 0 or more
cases.c: point 'p1' on device 'plc0' address: 'step' must be a finite number of 0 or more

cases.name: unknown point key
cases.rust: point 'p1' on device 'plc0' address: unknown key 'rate'
cases.c: point 'p1' on device 'plc0' address: unknown key 'rate'

cases.name: unsupported datatype
cases.rust: point 'p1' on device 'plc0': datatype must be float64, int32, bool or string
cases.c: point 'p1' on device 'plc0': datatype must be float64, int32, bool or string

cases.name: raw mode
cases.rust: point 'p1' on device 'plc0': the bench module supports typed points only
cases.c: point 'p1' on device 'plc0': the bench module supports typed points only

cases.name: resolution below 1 ms
cases.rust: device 'plc0' protocol_address: 'ts_resolution' must be at least 1ms
cases.c: device 'plc0' protocol_address: 'ts_resolution' must be at least 1ms
